about:
Moroso Performance Products is based in Guilford, Connecticut, and operates a manufacturing facility in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania where its ignition wire is produced. The company markets its components under two primary brands, Moroso and Competition Engineering (C.E.).

The product line spans oil pans and accessories, valve covers, ignition wire technologies, electrical system components, dry sump tanks and pumps, wet sump pumps, tools, roll cage kits and accessories, wheel-e bars, drag tires and accessories, chemicals and lubricants, air cleaners, catch can breather tanks, multi-angle spark plug boots, fittings, brackets, and hardware. Applications cover a range of engine platforms including Big Block Chevrolet, Small Block Ford, GM LS series, and Toyota JZ engines. The company's ignition wire is manufactured in Philadelphia, while other components such as oil pans, valve covers, and dry sump systems are offered under the Moroso label; Competition Engineering supplies roll cages in mild steel or chrome moly configurations ranging from 8- to 12-point designs, along with wheel-e bars for traction control.

Moroso serves automotive performance builders and racers across drag racing, road racing, and street performance segments. The company emphasizes new product development, with a 2026 supplement introducing over 100 new items, and provides technical resources including product instructions, tech videos, and catalogs through its dealer network.
